=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 1753-1756 in resolve_orchestrator_engine_sha | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: resolve_orchestrator_engine_sha checks `[ -d .codex-workflow-src ]` and executes `git -C .codex-workflow-src rev-parse HEAD` without verifying that `.codex-workflow-src` is an actual git repository (contains `.git`). When `.codex-workflow-src` is an unversioned directory of scripts (such as the stand-in support directory introduced by `_run_poller` in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:869-873`), `git -C` traverses upward and resolves HEAD from the parent git repository (the consumer repo in production, or `sandbox` in tests), directly violating the documented invariant that it must never guess from the consumer's own HEAD.
  WHY: `ORCHESTRATOR_ENGINE_SHA` resolves to the parent repository's commit SHA with `source=support_checkout` instead of remaining empty/unresolved. Consequently, any project in `failed` status with label `ai:security-pass-failed` where `security_pass_failed_engine_sha` is unset or different erroneously triggers `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET`, resetting project status to `security-pass` and re-auditing. In `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`, this causes `test_security_pass_waive_command_rejects_bots_and_malformed_ids` (failing `assert latest_state["status"] == "failed"` with `AssertionError: author` because status becomes `in_progress`), `test_security_pass_waive_command_after_dedup_marker_is_ignored`, and `test_security_pass_auto_reset_unreadable_state_keeps_project_parked` (failing `assert "ORCHESTRATOR_ENGINE_SHA sha=unknown source=unresolved" in combined_log`) to fail, breaking CI matrix jobs `orchestrate-poll (1)`, `(2)`, and `(3)` and the aggregate `lint` check.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
